notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content: Beating the game as Gobbledygunk would get you the Steam Achievement, but would not count for 100%. This has been fixed.

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content: Virulent Vessels patch 2! Fixed a *very* obscure bug where if u had the old version of VV downloaded from itch way back when, the game would crash when u tried to open the steam version. Also, added a control screen, since I never had one before... Oops. Sorry to everyone who was confused! Also, the game moves a bit faster now.
